headlines.title: Voting gets underway in the midterm elections
headlines.description: Voters are heading to the polls in a critical midterm election that will decide which party controls Congress. NBC News’ Ryan Nobles reports.

headlines.title: NBC News Exit Poll: How it works and how we use the results on election night
headlines.description: Before votes are tallied on election night, exit polls offer an early look at who is voting and what is motivating their choices.
headlines.source: Stephanie Perry, NBC News Exit Poll Desk

headlines.title: Inside the Decision Desk: When will we know Senate and House control?
headlines.description: In 2024, Donald Trump’s election night wins in the presidential battlegrounds of Georgia, North Carolina, Texas and Florida meant that most Americans went to bed on Tuesday with a good idea of the result of the election — and woke up to the networks having called enough states to declare Trump the president-elect.

headlines.title: Floods and severe weather beset parts of the U.S. on Election Day
headlines.description: Flash flooding, heavy rainfall and tornadoes have forced election officials in three different regions across the United States to move polling locations, scrambling Election Day plans in hot-button races.

headlines.title: Trump sets the stage for potential GOP losses, says party ‘gave this a very strong shot’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump acknowledged historical trends against the president’s party in midterm elections, saying Monday, “We gave this a very strong shot.”

headlines.title: In top Senate race states, gas and grocery costs rose faster than the national average
headlines.description: From gas and groceries to housing and wage growth, midterm voters who are being squeezed by inflation say the economy is their top issue this Election Day.

headlines.title: Interactive graphic: Road to a House majority
headlines.description: Congressional Democrats could take control of the House or the Republicans could hang on.

headlines.title: Escaped Tennessee inmate captured, authorities say
headlines.description: Jacob Allen Morley, the convicted murderer who escaped from a Tennessee prison, is in custody, the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation said Tuesday.

headlines.title: U.S. will stop $4B in aid to Israel at the end of the year, Trump says
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said Tuesday that he has made a deal with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for the United States to stop sending $4 billion in aid annually to Israel.

headlines.title: U.S. carries out strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island
headlines.description: The U.S. carried out limited strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island despite President Trump saying that strikes would not be carried out on Iran before the midterms. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez reports.

headlines.title: Father shares final texts from 24-year-old runner who collapsed during NYC marathon
headlines.description: Rachel Apa died Sunday before she could cross the finish line during her first marathon.

headlines.title: Supreme Court hears Catholic plea to participate in Colorado preschool program
headlines.description: The Supreme Court hears arguments over whether Catholic entities should be exempted from Colorado’s anti-discrimination rules for its taxpayer-funded preschool program.
